'''Chicks''' are baby [[chicken]]s that can be found at various farms. Unlike chickens, they do not drop [[feather]]s or [[raw chicken]].

There are also [[Chick (Blooming Burrow, non-attackable)|non-attackable variants]] found at the stands in the [[Blooming Burrow]].
